children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the workflow execution.

children.name: execution
children.description: The execution details of the workflow.

children.name: steps
children.description:
The details of the workflow execution's steps.
The key is the step's ID, and the value is the step's details.

children.name: context
children.description:
The context of the workflow execution.
This includes the data, errors and the output of the step and compensation functions of the workflow execution.

children.name: data
children.description: The data of the workflow execution.

children.name: compensate
children.description:
The output of the compensation function of the workflow execution.
The key is the step's ID, and the value is the compensation function's output.

These details are only included for steps that have their `saveResponse` property set to `true`.

children.name: errors
children.description: The errors of the workflow execution.

children.name: state
children.description: The state of the workflow execution.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the workflow execution was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date the workflow execution was updated.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: The date the workflow execution was deleted.
